headline: Oil Prices Rise Past $116 Amid Middle East Supply Jitters
summary: Oil prices climbed past $116 a barrel, approaching Iranian conflict highs amid heightened Middle East supply jitters.
why: Crude oil price fluctuations directly influence global energy input costs, transportation expenses, and inflationary pressures.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Geopolitical supply concerns in the Middle East drive up physical and futures crude oil prices.

why_moved: Supply disruption fears stemming from Middle East tensions prompted aggressive buying in energy markets.
